mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions at Fireman's Park. Tonight, the space station will be visible starting at 6:31 PM, rising in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb before traveling East Northeast toward Fitchburg and Madison, appearing almost directly overhead.

City Hall is currently processing several public notices for the November general election. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review development projects, including a site plan and traffic analysis for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.

We have a busy schedule! Yoga at Insight Wellness is today, followed by ART House 360 tonight. Hop Haus Trivia is happening tomorrow, and we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee both happening tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I first offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Devil's Food Cake. The restaurant is currently open, so there is plenty of time to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM.
